subject: Exec package: Q3 investor briefing & OKR check - finalization plan
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Board Secretariat <sec@highwaterpartners.com>
Date: 2028-09-03T08:14:00Z
Subject: Exec package: Q3 investor briefing & OKR check - draft attached

Team —

Attached is v1 of the Q3 executive brief for the upcoming investor QBR (see attachment). High-level asks:
- Can each of you review your sections by EOD Friday (Sept 6)?
- Finance: please confirm ARR / MRR and burn cadence on slide 6.
- Product: we need a one-slide summary of OKR progress vs. plan (no more than 5 bullets).
- Legal/Privacy: double-check the compliance slide (SOC2 / encryption notes) — external partners will review this.

Context: Highwater asked for a refresh ahead of their Sept 12 board. We agreed to send a finalized deck to their Secretariat on Sept 7. I pulled together the deck to focus on: operational KPIs (latency, cost/unit), revenue snapshot, platform reliability incidents, and a short product roadmap highlight.

Attachments: [attachment: Q3_exec_brief_draft_v1.pptx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation, 3.2MB)]
Drive link: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1aBcDeFgHIjK/view?usp=sharing

Thanks — short comments preferred (highlight change + why).

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Strategic Projects | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-03T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec package: Q3 investor briefing & OKR check - draft attached

Thanks Tessa — read-through notes inline (see short bullets).

Quick hits:
- Slide 6 (financials): the MRR export I ran this morning is slightly different from what you have; I'll attach the workbook. FinanceOps is still reconciling a handful of annualized credits for Platform customers (should be finalized by Friday).
- Slide 9 (OKRs): please remove the detailed owner-level progress rows — investors want a product-level summary. I recommend: 3 bullets for Completed, 2 bullets for At-Risk, 1 bullet for Ask/Decision.
- Slide 12 (roadmap): sensitive feature ETA is flagged by Product as tentative. We should strip exact dates and use quarter windows for the investor deck.

Attachment: [attachment: Q3_fin_update.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 120KB)]

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-04T09:26:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec package: Q3 investor briefing & OKR check - draft attached

+1 to Laura's ask on removing owner-level rows. Also a couple of product notes:
- Please redact any internal benchmarking slides that show exact customer names or per-customer performance. Use aggregated percentiles instead.
- For the cost-per-token slide, include the quantization/infra knobs we used to hit the numbers (short note) but avoid naming specific GPU partners.

I did a quick pass on slide order and suggest moving the incident timeline earlier (right after KPIs) — investors want reliability up front.

I'll be OOO Thursday morning but can sign off on the redacted deck by Thursday afternoon.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
CTO (interim) | Redwood Inference

From: Board Secretariat <sec@highwaterpartners.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: André Dupont <andre.dupont@northbridge.vc>, Legal Intake <legal@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2028-09-05T14:11:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec package: Q3 investor briefing & OKR check - draft attached

Hi Tessa — thanks for sharing. A couple of asks from the Secretariat and Legal:
- Confirm final delivery date: we require the board packet no later than 09/07 COB to circulate to Board members.
- Please add a one-slide compliance appendix that outlines SOC2 status, data retention policy, and encryption-in-transit details. Legal would also like a short note on incident post-mortem access (who to contact for audit logs).
- If possible, provide a short summary page with the top three asks of the Board (decisions needed).

We will also distribute to a subset of LPs prior to the meeting. If there are any slides that must be redacted for IP or partner confidentiality, indicate those clearly in the deck.

—Secretariat (Highwater Partners)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Board Secretariat <sec@highwaterpartners.com>
Date: 2028-09-06T17:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec package: Q3 investor briefing & OKR check - draft attached

Team — consolidating plan and timeline: 
1) Laura: final financial workbook and one-slide summary due Sept 6, 11:00 PT (received earlier today — thank you).
2) Vivek/Jonas: redaction pass completed, move incident timeline to slide 3 by 12:00 PT Sept 6. Jonas to own the edits.
3) Stephanie: add compliance appendix (SOC2, retention, audit contact) and a single "asks for the board" slide. Please coordinate with Legal Intake (cc'd earlier).
4) I will produce the final investor-facing PDF and send to Highwater Secretariat by Sept 7, COB.

Attachments: [attachment: Q3_exec_brief_final_v2.pptx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation, 3.6MB)]
